title_zh: 读宁德时代半年报：让利润与现金流坐在同一张桌上
title_en: Reading CATL: put earnings and cash flow on the same page
summary_zh: 一份电池龙头的半年报，也是练习核对利润、现金流和资本投入的好材料。
summary_en: A battery maker’s interim report offers a useful exercise in reconciling earnings, operating cash flow and capital spending.
source_title: 宁德时代新能源科技股份有限公司 2026 年半年度报告
source_author: 宁德时代 / CATL · 巨潮资讯网
body_zh:
## 为什么选这份资料

报告把主要财务指标、管理层讨论和完整财务报表放在一起，适合练习从经营叙述回到财务验证。

## 带着一个问题读

利润增长如何转化为现金？先对照净利润与经营现金流，再检查应收、存货、应付的变化，并另看资本投入。短期差异可能来自营运资金时点，不能单凭一个季度判断盈利质量。

## 资料的边界

这是公司披露。产品前景与未来计划仍需后续经营数据验证，半年报本身不能回答当前估值是否有吸引力。
body_en:
## Why read it

The report brings financial highlights, management discussion and financial statements together. It is useful for moving from a business narrative to financial verification.

## A question to carry through

How do earnings become cash? Compare profit with operating cash flow, inspect receivables, inventory and payables, then examine capital spending separately. Timing in working capital can explain short-term differences; one quarter cannot settle earnings quality.

## Limits of the source

This is a company disclosure. Product prospects and future plans require subsequent operating evidence. The report alone cannot establish whether today’s valuation is attractive.
